description: This file contains a Python class 'ReadnoiseMonitor' that generates Bokeh plots for monitoring readnoise data from JWST instruments, including data loading, processing, and visualization updates.

classes.name: ReadnoiseMonitor
classes.description: A Bokeh-based class for visualizing readnoise data from JWST instruments, with methods for data loading, processing, and plot updating.

methods.name: input_parameters
methods.description: Property getter and setter for instrument and aperture parameters used to filter data.

methods.name: identify_tables
methods.description: Determines which database table to query based on the instrument.

methods.name: load_data
methods.description: Queries the database for readnoise data matching the specified aperture.

methods.name: pre_init
methods.description: Initializes default parameters before the main setup.

methods.name: post_init
methods.description: Loads data and updates plots after initialization.

methods.name: update_mean_readnoise_figures
methods.description: Updates Bokeh plots showing mean readnoise over time for each amplifier.

methods.name: update_readnoise_diff_plots
methods.description: Updates the difference image and histogram plots for readnoise.
